value.description: Configure EOS event handlers for device sets

inputfield_actionCommand.name: actionCommand
inputfield_actionCommand.label: Action Command
inputfield_actionCommand.description: The bash command or script to run when triggered. For single-line: e.g. touch /tmp/test. For CLI: e.g. FastCli -p 15 -c "copy running-config startup-config"

inputfield_advancedConfig.name: advancedConfig
inputfield_advancedConfig.label: Advanced Settings
inputfield_advancedConfig.description: Optional advanced settings for timeout, asynchronous mode, threshold, and repeat interval.

inputfield_asynchronous.name: asynchronous
inputfield_asynchronous.label: Asynchronous
inputfield_asynchronous.description: Run the action immediately instead of queuing. WARNING: Use with caution — disables the built-in queuing mechanism. Not recommended with on-logging triggers.

inputfield_conditionExpr.name: conditionExpr
inputfield_conditionExpr.label: Condition Expression
inputfield_conditionExpr.description: Counter condition expression using Python-style operators (e.g. Fap*.Ddp2BuffCrcErrCnt.delta > 100). Use bashCmd."<command>" for custom bash counters.

inputfield_countersPollInterval.name: countersPollInterval
inputfield_countersPollInterval.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
inputfield_countersPollInterval.description: How often to evaluate the counter condition.

inputfield_customConditionScript.name: customConditionScript
inputfield_customConditionScript.label: Condition Script
inputfield_customConditionScript.description: Multi-line bash or python script for the custom condition. Use exit $EVENT_DETECTED or exit $EVENT_NOT_DETECTED for return codes. Do not include the leading 'condition bash' or trailing 'EOF' — those are generated automatically.

inputfield_customPollInterval.name: customPollInterval
inputfield_customPollInterval.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
inputfield_customPollInterval.description: How often to run the custom condition script.

inputfield_delay.name: delay
inputfield_delay.label: Delay (seconds)
inputfield_delay.description: Delay in seconds between the event and the action. EOS default is 20 seconds.

inputfield_deviceSets.name: deviceSets
inputfield_deviceSets.label: Event Handler Device Sets
inputfield_deviceSets.description: Assign event handlers to a set of devices.

inputfield_eventHandlers.name: eventHandlers
inputfield_eventHandlers.label: Event Handlers
inputfield_eventHandlers.description: Define one or more event handlers.

inputfield_handlerName.name: handlerName
inputfield_handlerName.label: Handler Name
inputfield_handlerName.description: Unique name for this event handler.

inputfield_intfName.name: intfName
inputfield_intfName.label: Interface Name or Range
inputfield_intfName.description: Interface name or range (e.g. Ethernet1, Ethernet1-36, Port-Channel1).

inputfield_intfTriggerOn.name: intfTriggerOn
inputfield_intfTriggerOn.label: Interface Trigger On
inputfield_intfTriggerOn.description: What interface change triggers the handler.

inputfield_loggingPollInterval.name: loggingPollInterval
inputfield_loggingPollInterval.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
inputfield_loggingPollInterval.description: How often to poll for the logging event.

inputfield_loggingRegex.name: loggingRegex
inputfield_loggingRegex.label: Syslog Regex
inputfield_loggingRegex.description: Regular expression to match against syslog messages (e.g. BGP, %REDUNDANCY-5-OTHER_STANDBY).

inputfield_onCountersConfig.name: onCountersConfig
inputfield_onCountersConfig.label: on-counters Settings
inputfield_onCountersConfig.description: Settings for the on-counters trigger type. Only used when Trigger Type is on-counters.

inputfield_onCustomConditionConfig.name: onCustomConditionConfig
inputfield_onCustomConditionConfig.label: on-custom-condition Settings
inputfield_onCustomConditionConfig.description: Settings for the on-custom-condition trigger type. Requires EOS 4.33.0F+. Only used when Trigger Type is on-custom-condition.

inputfield_onIntfConfig.name: onIntfConfig
inputfield_onIntfConfig.label: on-intf Settings
inputfield_onIntfConfig.description: Settings for the on-intf trigger type. Only used when Trigger Type is on-intf.

inputfield_onLoggingConfig.name: onLoggingConfig
inputfield_onLoggingConfig.label: on-logging Settings
inputfield_onLoggingConfig.description: Settings for the on-logging trigger type. Only used when Trigger Type is on-logging.

inputfield_repeatCount.name: repeatCount
inputfield_repeatCount.label: Repeat Count
inputfield_repeatCount.description: Maximum number of action triggers within the repeat interval. Default is 1 if not specified.

inputfield_repeatInterval.name: repeatInterval
inputfield_repeatInterval.label: Repeat Interval (seconds)
inputfield_repeatInterval.description: Time window in seconds to limit action triggers. No more than the repeat count actions will fire within this window.

inputfield_thresholdCount.name: thresholdCount
inputfield_thresholdCount.label: Threshold Count
inputfield_thresholdCount.description: Number of events required within the threshold window to trigger the action.

inputfield_thresholdWindow.name: thresholdWindow
inputfield_thresholdWindow.label: Threshold Window (seconds)
inputfield_thresholdWindow.description: Sliding time window in seconds for the threshold. Action only triggers if the event count is met within this window.

inputfield_timeout.name: timeout
inputfield_timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
inputfield_timeout.description: Maximum action duration in seconds. Default/minimum is 10 seconds.

inputfield_timeoutTerminate.name: timeoutTerminate
inputfield_timeoutTerminate.label: Terminate on Timeout
inputfield_timeoutTerminate.description: Terminate the action if it exceeds the timeout. Requires EOS 4.33.1F+.

inputfield_triggerOnConfigDisabled.name: triggerOnConfigDisabled
inputfield_triggerOnConfigDisabled.label: Disable Trigger on Config
inputfield_triggerOnConfigDisabled.description: Prevent the action from running when the event handler configuration is applied. Requires EOS 4.26.0F+.

inputfield_triggerType.name: triggerType
inputfield_triggerType.label: Trigger Type
inputfield_triggerType.description: The event type that triggers this handler. Must be explicitly selected.

value._note: Live keyed Studio mainline GET includes template+inputSchema; use Studio/all or keyed Studio for search, not StudioConfig/all (no mainline rows).
